info.title: Project 23 Enrollment Requirement Validator API
info.description: Week17 implemented contract. Local HTTP is fictional development only; production middleware requires HTTPS. No real tokens/examples included. Laravel framework /up is outside this application API and is liveness only.

get.description: Minimal, no-store; does not prove DB readiness.

post.description: 5 attempts/minute. Both roles use this endpoint; invalid credentials return 422.

patch.summary: Submit or resubmit own Pending/Rejected item
patch.description: Clears old correction remarks; cannot self-approve; no request body required. Required role: student.

delete.description: Students cascade related records; destructive action restricted to staff. Not exposed by the bounded Flutter review screen. Required role: enrollment_staff.

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum token; keep out of browser storage/screenshots/repository.

feedback.description: Only returned when status is Rejected and correction exists.

student.description: Loaded staff responses only; omitted for student.

RequirementCreate.description: Unique name per student. status/remarks prohibited; initial Pending.

RequirementUpdate.description: At least one field required. student_id prohibited. Decision only from Submitted; Rejected requires nonblank remarks. Return 409 for stale/non-submitted decisions.
